tools.name: calculate_position_size
tools.description: Calculate position quantity and notional for a linear crypto futures trade from user-specified account balance, risk percentage, entry and stop. Includes separate entry/stop fees and optional target profit and net R. Direction is derived. Use when asked how much to buy or sell for a specified risk budget. Ask for missing prices or risk preference; do not invent them. Does not calculate liquidation, leverage, inverse contracts, exchange lot rounding, signals, or execute orders.

instrumentType.description: Linear quote-margined instruments only. Inverse contracts and liquidation are unsupported.

quoteCurrency.description: Currency shared by all monetary inputs. Defaults to USD; no currency conversion is performed.

entryPrice.description: Planned entry price in quote currency per base unit.

stopPrice.description: Planned stop price. Direction is derived from entry and stop.

fees.description: User-supplied rates. Omission explicitly assumes zero fees; no exchange rate lookup is performed.

entryPercent.description: Entry fee percent, e.g. 0.05 means 0.05%, not 5%.

targetPercent.description: Target exit fee percent; defaults to stopPercent.

accountBalance.description: Account balance in the same quote currency as prices.

riskPercent.description: User-chosen account risk percentage, e.g. 1 means 1%. Never infer a risk preference.

targetPrice.description: Optional profit target, opposite the stop relative to entry.

tools.name: calculate_net_risk_reward
tools.description: Compare gross and fee-adjusted reward-to-risk, loss and profit per unit, and breakeven win rate for a linear trade with known entry, stop and target. Accepts distinct entry/stop/target fee percentages. Use for questions about a planned R ratio or how fees change it. Direction is derived from entry and stop. Does not fetch venue fees or predict execution, liquidation, or trade outcomes.

instrumentType.description: Linear quote-margined instruments only. Inverse contracts and liquidation are unsupported.

quoteCurrency.description: Currency shared by all monetary inputs. Defaults to USD; no currency conversion is performed.

entryPrice.description: Planned entry price in quote currency per base unit.

stopPrice.description: Planned stop price. Direction is derived from entry and stop.

fees.description: User-supplied rates. Omission explicitly assumes zero fees; no exchange rate lookup is performed.

entryPercent.description: Entry fee percent, e.g. 0.05 means 0.05%, not 5%.

targetPercent.description: Target exit fee percent; defaults to stopPercent.

targetPrice.description: Profit target price, opposite the stop relative to entry.

tools.name: analyze_trade_performance
tools.description: Analyze up to 500 chronological closed trades supplied by the user, each with net P&L after costs and original risk. Returns win rate, profit factor, expectancy in currency and R, total net R, and optional closed-trade equity drawdown when initial equity is supplied. Use for reviewing an existing trade sample. No account access, deposits, intratrade drawdown, forecasts, signals, or new risk recommendations.

quoteCurrency.description: Currency shared by all monetary inputs. Defaults to USD; no currency conversion is performed.

initialEquity.description: Starting equity before the ordered trades. Required only for equity drawdown metrics. No deposits or withdrawals are modeled.

netPnl.description: Realized P&L after all fees and costs. Positive is profit; negative is loss.

initialRisk.description: Original planned risk amount, including planned fees if that is your convention. Do not replace it with a later stop risk.

trades.description: Closed trades ordered chronologically, all using the same currency and risk convention. Maximum 500.
